issue_title: [Bug] Inconsistent validation between Todo constructor and rename(): constructor allow
approach: Add text validation and normalization to __post_init__ for consistency with rename()
risks: Existing code that creates Todo objects with whitespace-padded text will now have text stripped
Existing code that creates Todo objects with empty/whitespace-only text will now raise ValueError
summary: Fixed inconsistent text validation between Todo constructor/from_dict and rename() by adding the same validation logic (strip + empty check) to __post_init__. This ensures all entry points enforce the same rules.
